title: A doubly linked list with a sentinel
hints: With a sentinel, `pushFront(v)` is `insertBefore(sentinel.next, v)` and `pushBack(v)` is `insertBefore(&sentinel, v)`. Write `insertBefore` once with the four pointer assignments from the lesson.
To reverse, visit every node in the ring once, the sentinel included, and swap its `prev` and `next`. Careful about which pointer leads to the next node after you have swapped them.
